encyclopedia.summary: Brain's Base's 2021 adaptation of Yoshitoki Oima's manga. An immortal being that can take other forms meets a boy, takes a name, loses him, and passes through the lives of many people while learning what living costs. Each episode jumps far in time, so the eternal being meets human loss over and over.

key_facts.value: Yoshitoki Oima's manga To Your Eternity

highlights: The lead enters a different person's life each arc and learns the weight of attachment.
It returns to death repeatedly but stays on the time after loss rather than the cruelty.
The manga finished in 2024, and the anime is still moving toward that ending.

related.note: The original manga — the same story read on paper

An omnibus of people and beings passing each other

encyclopedia.summary: Ajia-do's 2019 adaptation of Miya Kazuki's light novels. A girl whose illness kills her if she touches books is reborn into a world without them and sets out to rebuild paper and printing from nothing. It never solves problems with fantasy power; it walks through papermaking, type and distribution as real processes.

key_facts.value: Miya Kazuki's light novels Ascendance of a Bookworm

highlights: Treats making books as a problem of craft and organisation.
The protagonist's illness supplies both the world's logic and the story's tension.
It passes through noble rank and trade seen from a small girl's height.
